rater: single rater (Claude), blind to trait key at time of rating

scale.type_cue: wording reveals type via a repeated trigger phrase

global_notes: s04, s11, s12 carry no stated cost on any card, unlike the other 12 scenes; the costs elsewhere are uniform enough that their absence is noticeable but not a within-scene problem.

The kind of cost is patterned: physical discomfort (oily hands, cold, by hand, heavy, crawling); work that may lead nowhere or take days; others may dislike it or it gets thrown out; blame or people walking away; slow, careful, unseen work; giving up sleep or fun for others. That flavour is itself a cue.

Some costs make a card look selfish or idle rather than merely costly: 'while others do the climbing', 'even if the stall opens without you', 'even if it means climbing last', 'with little praise'. Others make a card look noble: 'even if you miss the repair', 'missing a night's sleep'.

s01-1.note: oily hands / no one to ask: hands-on plus alone pattern

s01-2.note: 'work out ... why' trigger; answer may come too late

s01-4.note: kind; the sacrifice reads as noble

s01.verdict: Balanced. s01-4 slightly most virtuous, s01-1 most useful; no clear winner.

s02-2.note: 'by hand'; only card that meets the midnight deadline

s02.verdict: Mild tilt to s02-2 (it solves the deadline) and heavy cost on s02-4; acceptable.

s03-2.note: 'so nothing is missed'; 'while others do the climbing' reads as shirking

s03.verdict: s03-2 is the odd one out: its 'cost' is that others do the hard part, so it looks lazy rather than costly.

s04-1.note: 'teach children ... through games' (same frame as s12-3)

s04-4.note: 'and why'; noticeably longer and more elaborate than the other three

s04.verdict: No virtue winner, but s04-4 stands out by length (73 chars against roughly 45 to 50). No costs in this scene.

s05-3.note: 'alone ... freezing wind': solitary physical hardship pattern

s05-4.note: rescuing lost travellers is the most heroic option

s05.verdict: All four are worthy, and s05-4 edges ahead because it rescues lost people.

s06-2.note: the setup baits it, but 'stall opens without you' reads as neglecting duty

s07-2.note: 'sore arms and wet feet' body-cost pattern

s07-3.note: night-long caring is a sacrifice-of-sleep pattern (also s14-3)

s08-2.note: 'so none go missing'; 'slow, careful job' sounds dull

s08-4.note: 'repair ... with tools'; directly fixes the setup problem

s08.verdict: s08-2 is the least attractive because its cost describes the task itself as dull.

s09-1.note: drawing while the group must reach the top looks self-indulgent

s09-3.note: 'every ... against the safety list'; safety reads as virtuous

s09.verdict: s09-1 is the odd one out: it does nothing toward the group goal, and 'climbing last' adds a selfish tone.

s10-1.note: 'weigh and record'; low value in a crisis

s10.verdict: s10-1 is the weakest: bookkeeping while people argue.

s12-3.note: 'teach children ... through stories' (same frame as s04-1)

s13-1.note: 'keep ... on time'; 'little praise' frames it as thankless

s13.verdict: s13-1 is the least attractive because 'little praise' is a status cost, not a task cost.

s14-3.note: night-long sacrifice pattern; in a healing house this is the 'right' answer

s14.verdict: s14-3 dominates: comforting the sick in a healing house is the morally obvious pick.
